name: Sit to stand
instructions: Rise using your legs, then lower yourself with control.

name: Supported mini squat
instructions: Use the chair back for balance.
Bend your knees within a comfortable range, then return upright.

name: Supported calf raise
instructions: Raise your heels slowly and lower them with control.

name: Supported sideways leg lift
instructions: Lift one leg sideways without leaning, lower it, and switch sides.

name: Standing leg extension
instructions: Move one straight leg behind you without arching your back; alternate sides.

name: Wall press-up
instructions: Face a wall with palms at chest height.
Bend your elbows to approach the wall, then push away slowly.

name: Light dumbbell biceps curl
instructions: Keep your upper arms near your torso.
Lift the weights toward your shoulders, then lower them slowly.
